latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the SPIN Discovery Question Planner skill for structured B2B sales call preparation.

- Produces a pre-call question bank organized by SPIN (Situation, Problem, Implication, Need-payoff) type — not a flat, generic list.
- Integrates Rackham’s empirically-validated process, including a 3-step Implication question planning sub-workflow.
- Connects seller’s real product capabilities to tailored Need-payoff questions.
- Provides a sequence/branching guide for when to move between SPIN question types.
- Designed for account executives, SDRs, solutions consultants, and founder-led sellers preparing for discovery or follow-up sales calls.
